### Observed differences

- A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 traces) and appears exactly once in every trace of the later window (200 of 200), at a late position in the case (median relative position 0.8, mean 0.76). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the later window, A01 always precedes A08: the two co-occur in every trace, with A01 first in 100% of them. In the earlier window, A08 also ran in every trace, but never together with A01. [REL004]
- A04 and A09 now route into A01. Earlier, about 60 in 100 of A04's observed outgoing transitions went to A08 (about 20 to A07, 19 to A06); later, about 88 in 100 go to A01. A09 shifted similarly, from about 69 in 100 to A08 to about 91 in 100 to A01. Whenever A04 or A09 occurs in the later window, it comes before A01. [DIR002, DIR003, REL001, REL005]
- From A01, flow goes to A08 in about 73 in 100 observed transitions, to A07 in about 17 and to A06 in about 11. [DIR001]
- Distances to A08 moved about one step later: A04→A08 went from lag 1 in about 60% of observations (lag 2 about 40%) to lag 2 (about 51%) and lag 3 (about 49%); A09→A08 went from lag 1 (about 69%) to lag 2 (about 74%) and lag 3 (about 26%); the A06→A08 and A07→A08 distances also shifted about one step later. [LAG003, LAG007, LAG004, LAG005]
- A04 and A09 kept similar participation (about 52% vs 54% and 49% vs 47% of traces) but their relative positions moved earlier (mean 0.65→0.50 and 0.74→0.62), consistent with an activity added after them. [POS002, POS003]
- A06 and A07, which never co-occurred with A01 earlier, now usually do and usually precede it (A06 before A01 in about 36 in 100 traces, A01 before A06 in about 10; A07 before A01 in about 37, A01 before A07 in about 17). [REL002, REL003]
- Overall, 19 control-flow items qualified out of 36 tested units, against roughly 0.18 expected if nothing had changed, so the volume of flagged behaviour far exceeds what an unchanged process typically produces. [screening]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that a new activity, A01, was added to the flow between the block containing A04 and A09 and A08: in the later window A01 runs exactly once per case at a late position (median 0.8) and always before A08, while A04 and A09 — which previously passed control mainly onward to A08 — now pass it mainly to A01, and the A04→A08 and A09→A08 distances grew by about one step, as expected if A01 sits between them and A08. [OCC001, POS001, REL004, DIR002, DIR003, LAG003, LAG007]

The supporting signs are strong: the participation change is complete (0 of 200 traces before, 200 of 200 after, once per trace), the ordering with A08 is invariant across all later traces, both predecessors redirect consistently, and the lag shifts all point the same way; with 19 items against roughly 0.18 expected without change, chance cannot account for the ensemble. Note that the agreeing items largely describe one underlying difference rather than independent confirmations. [OCC001, REL004, DIR002, DIR003, LAG003, LAG007, screening]

A competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out: A01 may not be genuinely new but simply too rare to appear in 200 earlier traces before becoming frequent; even then, the rerouting of A04 and A09 and the one-step distance increases remain real behavioural differences in the later window. Also, because A06 and A07 now usually precede A01 while their upstream source is not observed, A01's full set of predecessors beyond A04 and A09 is not established. [OCC001, REL002, REL003]

Other differences: A06 now appears somewhat less often (about 55 in 100 traces before vs about 47 in 100 after) and A07 somewhat more often (about 45 vs 54 in 100), which may be side-effects of the rerouting around A01; and the pairs A04→A06, A04→A07 and A09→A06, which were immediate earlier, now mostly sit two steps apart, though these items rest on only about 11–33 observations per window. [REL002, REL003, LAG001, LAG002, LAG006]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

Screening: 36 units tested, 19 items qualified, 0.18 expected by chance. That's a count many times larger than the expectation (19 vs 0.18, over 100x). So the screening comparison says the number of items cannot be explained by chance. So we move past "Insufficient evidence" based on count.

All items are control-flow family. No time (TWAIT) or resource items, so I must not discuss time or resources.

Now let's understand the behaviour.

OCC001: A01 — before: mean occurrences per trace 0.0, participation 0.0 (support before 0). After: mean 1.0, participation 1.0 (support after 200). So A01 was absent in the earlier window and appears in every trace in the later window, exactly once per trace (mean 1.0, recurrence support 0 — appears once per trace). This is an activity added / became mandatory. Empirical strength 0.995.

POS001: A01 — after: mean position 0.763 (normalized position, ~0.76 of the trace), median 0.8, q25 0.667, q75 0.833. So A01 occurs late in the trace, around position 0.76–0.8 of the trace length. Before: no support.

DIR001: A01's outgoing transitions — after: A08 0.725, A07 0.17, A06 0.105. So from A01, most flows go to A08 (~73 in 100), some to A07 (~17), some to A06 (~11). Before: empty (A01 not observed).

DIR002: A04's outgoing transitions — before: A08 0.60, A07 0.20, A06 0.19 (support 103 traces). After: A01 0.88, A07 0.065, A06 0.056 (support 107). So A04 previously flowed mostly to A08 (~60%), now flows mostly to A01 (~88%).

DIR003: A09's outgoing — before: A08 0.69, A06 0.22, A07 0.09 (support 97). After: A01 0.91, A07 0.054, A06 0.032 (support 93). So A09 previously flowed mostly to A08, now mostly to A01.

POS002: A04 — before: support 0.515, mean position 0.65. After: support 0.535, mean 0.50. So A04 occurs in about half the traces in both windows; its position moved earlier (mean 0.65 → 0.50).

POS003: A09 — before: support 0.485, mean 0.738. After: support 0.465, mean 0.624. A09 in about half the traces both windows; position earlier (0.74 → 0.62).

REL001 (A01, A04): before: A01 never occurs; A04 only (B_only) 0.515, neither 0.485. After: cooccurrence 0.535, A_only (A01 without A04) 0.465, B_before_A 0.535. So in the later window, whenever A04 occurs (53.5%), A01 occurs before it. A01 occurs in all traces; A04 in ~53.5%; when both, A01 first.

REL002 (A01, A06): before: B_only (A06 only) 0.55, neither 0.45. After: cooccurrence 0.465, A_only 0.535, B_before_A 0.36, A_before_B 0.105. So A06 occurs in ~55% before, ~46.5% after; when both, mostly A01 before A06 (36%) with some A06 before A01 (10.5%).

REL003 (A01, A07): before: B_only 0.45, neither 0.55. After: cooccurrence 0.535, A_only 0.465, B_before_A 0.365, A_before_B 0.17. Similar: A07 in ~45% before, ~53.5% after; A01 before A07 mostly.

REL004 (A01, A08): before: B_only 1.0 (A08 in every trace, A01 never). After: cooccurrence 1.0, A_before_B 1.0. So A08 in every trace in both windows; A01 now always occurs immediately... well, always before A08, in every trace. This is a strong structural signal: A01 inserted before A08 in every trace.

REL005 (A01, A09): before: B_only 0.485, neither 0.515. After: cooccurrence 0.465, A_only 0.535, B_before_A 0.465. So A09 in ~48.5% before, ~46.5% after; when both, A01 before A09.

LAG001 (A04, A06): before: lag 1 always. After: lag 1 in 32%, lag 2 in 68%. Support small (20 before, 19 after). Hmm, this is the ordered pair A04→A06 within five steps. Before, A06 followed A04 immediately (lag 1); after, usually two steps apart.

Wait — but DIR002 says A04 now flows mostly to A01 (0.88). So A04 → A01 → ... The lag between A04 and A06 increasing from 1 to 2 is consistent with A01 being inserted between A04 and its successors.

LAG002 (A04, A07): before lag 1 always (support 21); after lag 1 in 21%, lag 2 in 79% (support 33). Same pattern.

LAG003 (A04, A08): before lag 1 in 60%, lag 2 in 40% (support 103); after lag 2 in 51%, lag 3 in 49% (support 107). So the A04→A08 distance shifted from 1–2 to 2–3. Consistent with one activity (A01) inserted between.

LAG004 (A06, A08): before lags 1 (37%), 2 (24%), 3 (37%), 4 (2%); after lags 1 (23%), 2 (10%), 3 (30%), 4 (25%), 5 (13%). Shifted to longer lags. Support 110/93.

LAG005 (A07, A08): before lags 1 (33%), 2 (26%), 3 (31%), 4 (10%); after 1 (32%), 2 (11%), 3 (24%), 4 (21%), 5 (11%). Shifted longer.

LAG006 (A09, A06): before lag 1 always (support 21); after lag 1 (27%), lag 2 (73%) (support 11). Small support.

LAG007 (A09, A08): before lag 1 (69%), lag 2 (31%) (support 97); after lag 2 (74%), lag 3 (26%) (support 93). Shifted by one.
